name: Locate Animals or Plants

header.Components: V, S, M (fur from a bloodhound)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Name specific Beast/Plant kind; within five miles disclose nearest location/direction; no arbitrary monster type or exact named individual unless source permits.

rules.text: Describe or name a specific kind of Beast, Plant creature, or nonmagical plant.
You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.
